# Compile flags shared by the WebAssembly (build-wasm.sh) and Python (python/setup.py) builds.
# Parity between the two depends on identical flags: no fast-math, no FP contraction (FMA),
# no Eigen vectorization (Eigen 3.4 has no WebAssembly SIMD path, so both stay scalar), and
# sin/cos/atan/atan2 always call the vendored musl implementations (vendor/musl-math, see
# cflags-musl.txt) instead of being constant-folded or fused by the compiler.
-std=c++20
-O3
-ffp-contract=off
-DNDEBUG
-DEIGEN_NO_DEBUG
-DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE
-DEIGEN_DONT_PARALLELIZE
-DEIGEN_STACK_ALLOCATION_LIMIT=16384
-Wno-deprecated-declarations
-fno-builtin-sin
-fno-builtin-cos
-fno-builtin-sincos
-fno-builtin-atan
-fno-builtin-atan2
